scripts.build:public: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @bcm/public
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @bcm/admin
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @bcm/backend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @bcm/backend && npm run build --workspace @bcm/public && npm run build --workspace @bcm/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @bcm/backend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test:public && npm run test:admin
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --workspace @bcm/public && npm run test:e2e --workspace @bcm/admin
